required_behavior: Direct scrolling without entering a mode: (1) mouse wheel over any pane scrolls that pane's view (about 3 lines per notch); (2) Shift+PgUp / Shift+PgDn (CSI 5;2~ / 6;2~) scroll the focused pane by a page. Neither is forwarded to the pane in these cases. Keep the scroll-position indicator in the pane title.

Auto return: while a pane is scrolled back (offset > 0), any other key or paste destined for that pane first returns its view to live and is then delivered unchanged (no extra key needed). Other panes keep their scroll position.

Mouse capture: enable xterm mouse reporting with SGR encoding on the outer terminal (?1000h ?1006h) when the UI starts; disable it (?1000l ?1006l) on every exit path exactly like 2004 (normal, detach, signal, connection loss, exception) and when toggled off. Provide prefix m to toggle mouse capture on/off with a notice; help overlay/footer mention that text selection needs Shift+drag while capture is on.

Mouse event handling: parse SGR mouse sequences (CSI < b ; x ; y M/m) in the input parser so they never leak to panes as text. Wheel over a pane whose application has enabled its own mouse tracking (DECSET 1000/1002/1003 observed in that pane's output, with 1006 for SGR) is forwarded to that pane translated to pane-local coordinates; otherwise it scrolls the view. If the pane is in the alternate screen without app mouse tracking, translate wheel to Up/Down arrow keys (xterm alternate-scroll behaviour) instead of scrolling history. A left click on a pane that has not enabled mouse tracking focuses that pane (focus frame, as prefix 1/2/3); clicks on panes with mouse tracking are forwarded translated. Ignore events on borders/header/footer.

Keep the explicit prefix [ scroll mode as a fallback. Fix delta-review P3s: F2 (prefix [ / prefix PgUp while already scrolled must not reset the anchor), F3 (history cleared by catch-up/generation change while scrolled: return to live with a notice), F4 (backend focus change exits scroll mode for consistency).
No change to backend/contracts; bracketed paste, catch-up, replay, 2004 tracking and signal restore stay intact.
